fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una fecha de caducidad al menos 3 meses posterior al día en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: Your passport must have a date of issue less than 10 years before the date you arrive.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una fecha de expedición de menos de 10 años antes de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive

entry.en: At Portuguese border control you may need to show an onward or return ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo portugués puede que debas mostrar un billete de continuación o de vuelta.
entry.quote:
At Portuguese border control you may need to show:

- 
an onward or return ticket

entry.en: On short stays into the Schengen area you may need to register biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.
entry.es: En estancias cortas en el espacio Schengen puede que debas registrar datos biométricos, como huellas dactilares y una foto.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.

entry.en: Children aged 17 and under travelling to Portugal alone or with someone who is not their parent or legal guardian must carry a letter of authorisation to travel.
entry.es: Los menores de 17 años o menos que viajen a Portugal solos o con una persona que no sea su padre, madre o tutor legal deben llevar una carta de autorización de viaje.
entry.quote: Children aged 17 and under travelling to Portugal alone, or with a person who is not their parent or legal guardian, must carry a letter of authorisation to travel.

entry.en: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.
entry.es: No se pueden llevar carne, leche ni productos que las contengan a países de la UE.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.

safety.en: Street crime is a risk, and thieves often work in teams using distraction techniques, so take care on public transport and at crowded stops.
safety.es: El delito callejero es un riesgo y los ladrones suelen actuar en grupo con técnicas de distracción, así que ten cuidado en el transporte público y en paradas concurridas.
safety.quote: Be alert to the risk of street crime. Take care on public transport and at crowded bus and tram stops. Thieves use distraction techniques and often work in teams.

safety.en: Attacks including sexual assaults are rare but do occur, with the highest risk late at night around popular nightlife locations.
safety.es: Las agresiones, incluidas las sexuales, son raras pero ocurren, con mayor riesgo de madrugada en zonas de ocio nocturno.
safety.quote: Attacks including sexual assaults, are rare but do occur. The risk is highest late at night around popular nightlife locations.

safety.en: Buy your own drinks and keep them in sight to avoid them being spiked.
safety.es: Compra tus propias bebidas y no las pierdas de vista para evitar que las adulteren.
safety.quote: Buy your own drinks and always keep them in sight to avoid them being spiked.

safety.en: There is an increased risk of wildfires from April to October when the weather is hot and dry, and they can start anywhere in Portugal.
safety.es: Hay mayor riesgo de incendios forestales de abril a octubre cuando hace calor y tiempo seco, y pueden empezar en cualquier lugar de Portugal.
safety.quote: There is an increased risk of wildfires from April to October when the weather is hot and dry. Wildfires can start anywhere in Portugal.

safety.en: At supervised beaches a red flag means you must not enter the water and yellow means it is only safe to paddle at the water's edge.
safety.es: En las playas vigiladas la bandera roja significa que no debes entrar al agua y la amarilla que solo es seguro mojarse en la orilla.
safety.quote: a red flag means you must not enter the water, yellow means it’s only safe to paddle at the water’s edge

safety.en: Pickpockets tend to target tourists and tourist-frequented areas more frequently.
safety.es: Los carteristas tienden a atacar con más frecuencia a turistas y zonas turísticas.
safety.quote: pickpockets do tend to target tourists and tourist-frequented areas more frequently.

health.en: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Marca el 112 y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Non-EU travellers are advised to buy basic travel medical insurance to cover the cost of treating serious injury after an accident.
health.es: A los viajeros no pertenecientes a la UE se les aconseja contratar un seguro médico de viaje básico para cubrir el tratamiento de lesiones graves tras un accidente.
health.quote: Non European Union travellers are advised to purchase traveller's basic medical insurance to cover serious physical injury treatment costs, in case of an accident.

health.en: There are strict rules around dispensing certain medicines in Portugal, including antibiotics.
health.es: Hay normas estrictas para dispensar ciertos medicamentos en Portugal, incluidos los antibióticos.
health.quote: There are strict rules around dispensing certain medicines in Portugal, including antibiotics.

health.en: Portugal's water sources are described as perfectly safe, though some people may prefer bottled water.
health.es: Se describe el agua de Portugal como perfectamente segura, aunque algunas personas prefieren agua embotellada.
health.quote: Portugal's water sources are perfectly safe, but some people may prefer bottled/spring water (água mineral).

health.en: The National Health Service 24-hour hotline is 808 24 24 24.
health.es: La línea telefónica 24 horas del Servicio Nacional de Salud es 808 24 24 24.
health.quote: The Serviço Nacional de Saúde (National Health Service) 24-hour hotline is 808 24 24 24.

health.en: Major cities are well served with medical and emergency facilities, and public hospitals are at European standards.
health.es: Las grandes ciudades cuentan con buenos servicios médicos y de emergencia, y los hospitales públicos tienen estándares europeos.
health.quote: Major cities are well served with medical and emergency facilities and public hospitals are at European standards.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 112.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 112.

help.en: The PSP is the public security police force that covers cities.
help.es: La PSP es la policía de seguridad pública que cubre las ciudades.
help.quote: Polícia de Segurança Pública (PSP) – the public security police force that covers cities

help.en: The GNR is the national guard that covers smaller towns and rural areas.
help.es: La GNR es la guardia nacional que cubre las localidades pequeñas y las zonas rurales.
help.quote: Guarda Nacional Republicana (GNR) – the national guard that covers smaller towns and rural areas

getting_in.en: Lisbon Portela Airport (LIS) is the main aviation hub, with many intercontinental connections with the Americas and Africa.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Lisboa Portela (LIS) es el principal centro aéreo, con muchas conexiones intercontinentales con América y África.
getting_in.quote: Lisbon Portela Airport (LIS IATA) is the main aviation hub, with many intercontinental connections with the Americas and Africa

getting_in.en: Porto Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport (OPO) serves Portugal's second-largest city and the entire north of the country.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto Francisco Sá Carneiro de Oporto (OPO) sirve a la segunda ciudad de Portugal y a todo el norte del país.
getting_in.quote: Porto Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport (OPO IATA), serving Portugal's second-largest city and the entire northern part of the country

getting_in.en: Faro Airport (FAO) serves the Algarve in the south, one of Europe's favourite holiday regions.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Faro (FAO) sirve al Algarve, en el sur, una de las regiones vacacionales favoritas de Europa.
getting_in.quote: Faro Airport (FAO IATA) serves Algarve in the south of the country, one of Europe's favourite holiday regions.

getting_in.en: Portugal's only land border is with Spain, with main crossings at Vila Real de Santo António, Elvas, Vilar Formoso and Valença do Minho.
getting_in.es: La única frontera terrestre de Portugal es con España, con pasos principales en Vila Real de Santo António, Elvas, Vilar Formoso y Valença do Minho.
getting_in.quote: Portugal's only land border is with Spain. The major national roads connect with Spain's road network, enabling road travel into mainland Europe. The main border crossings are at Vila Real de Santo António, Elvas, Vilar Formoso and Valença do Minho.

getting_in.en: The only international train options are the twice-daily Celta between Vigo and Porto and a once-daily regional service from Badajoz via Elvas to Entroncamento.
getting_in.es: Las únicas opciones de tren internacional son el Celta dos veces al día entre Vigo y Oporto y un servicio regional diario desde Badajoz vía Elvas hasta Entroncamento.
getting_in.quote: there are only two options: the twice-daily Celta service between Vigo, Spain, and Porto, and the once-daily regional service from Badajoz, Spain, via Elvas to Entroncamento

getting_in.en: There are direct buses to various Spanish cities as well as connections to Paris.
getting_in.es: Hay autobuses directos a varias ciudades españolas, además de conexiones con París.
getting_in.quote: There are direct buses to various Spanish cities, as well as connections to Paris

getting_around.en: Alfa-Pendular trains stop only at main city stations, and buying tickets in advance is recommended due to high demand.
getting_around.es: Los trenes Alfa Pendular solo paran en las estaciones de las ciudades principales y se recomienda comprar los billetes con antelación por la alta demanda.
getting_around.quote: Alfa-Pendular trains only stop at main city stations like Braga, Porto, Vila Nova de Gaia, Aveiro, Coimbra, Lisbon, and Faro. It's recommended to purchase your tickets in advance, due to high demand.

getting_around.en: Lisbon and Porto have clean, modern and air-conditioned metro systems.
getting_around.es: Lisboa y Oporto tienen sistemas de metro limpios, modernos y con aire acondicionado.
getting_around.quote: Lisbon and Porto, the two largest cities, have clean, modern and air-conditioned metro systems.

getting_around.en: Taxis are light beige or black with green roofs and have meters, but prices beyond the city limits are often negotiated.
getting_around.es: Los taxis son beige claro o negros con techo verde y tienen taxímetro, pero los precios fuera de la ciudad suelen negociarse.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are either light beige or black with green roofs. They have meters, but prices for rides beyond the city limits are often negotiated.

getting_around.en: Uber claims to serve the entire country, but availability may be spotty beyond Lisbon.
getting_around.es: Uber dice dar servicio en todo el país, pero la disponibilidad puede ser irregular fuera de Lisboa.
getting_around.quote: Uber claims to serve the entire country, but availability may be spotty beyond Lisbon.

getting_around.en: Portugal has electronic tolls known as Via Verde, and you need to register your licence plate or get a tag to use the main motorway system.
getting_around.es: Portugal tiene peajes electrónicos llamados Via Verde y hay que registrar la matrícula u obtener un dispositivo para usar la red principal de autopistas.
getting_around.quote: Portugal has a system of electronic tolls, known as "Via Verde" and you need to make arrangements to register you licence plate or to obtain a tag for tolling if you are going to use the main motorway system.

getting_around.en: The tolerated blood alcohol limit is 0.49‰, and exceeding it can bring a fine of up to €1,250 and a licence suspension of 1 to 12 months.
getting_around.es: El límite tolerado de alcohol en sangre es 0,49‰ y superarlo puede suponer una multa de hasta 1.250 € y la suspensión del carné de 1 a 12 meses.
getting_around.quote: The tolerated limit is 0.49‰; being above this limit is thus illegal and can result in a fine of up to €1,250 and licence suspension for 1–12 months.

money.quote: Portugal uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: ATMs labelled Multibanco or ATM Express that accept international cards can be found everywhere.
money.es: Los cajeros etiquetados como Multibanco o ATM Express que aceptan tarjetas internacionales se encuentran en todas partes.
money.quote: ATMs/cashpoints (labelled Multibanco or ATM Express) accepting international cards can be found everywhere

money.en: Euronet ATMs found in some areas charge high fees and use disadvantageous exchange rates.
money.es: Los cajeros Euronet de algunas zonas cobran comisiones altas y usan tipos de cambio desfavorables.
money.quote: Some areas are littered with Euronet ATMs - however similar to other countries, here as well they charge high fees and use disadvantageous exchange rates.

money.en: The standard VAT rate is 23%, with reduced rates of 13% or 6% on some items.
money.es: El tipo estándar de IVA es del 23%, con tipos reducidos del 13% o el 6% en algunos artículos.
money.quote: The standard rate is 23%, with reduced-rate items taxed at 13% or 6%.

money.en: Tipping is generally not expected in Portugal but is appreciated for exemplary service.
money.es: En general no se espera propina en Portugal, pero se agradece por un servicio ejemplar.
money.quote: Tipping is generally not expected in Portugal, but it is certainly appreciated if you have received exemplary service.

money.en: It is very common to be charged for the cover in restaurants even if you did not ask for it.
money.es: Es muy común que en los restaurantes te cobren el cubierto aunque no lo hayas pedido.
money.quote: it is very common to get charged for the cover in restaurants, even if you did not ask for it.

etiquette.en: When visiting churches or other religious monuments, try to wear appropriate clothes and keep silence.
etiquette.es: Al visitar iglesias u otros monumentos religiosos, intenta vestir de forma adecuada y guardar silencio.
etiquette.quote: when visiting churches or other religious monuments, try to wear appropriate clothes, and please keep silence.

etiquette.en: It is not unusual for women to sunbathe topless on Portuguese beaches, and there are several nudist beaches.
etiquette.es: No es raro que las mujeres tomen el sol en topless en las playas portuguesas, y hay varias playas nudistas.
etiquette.quote: It is not unusual for women to sunbathe topless on the beaches of Portugal, and there are several nudist beaches too.

etiquette.en: Portugal is generally gay-friendly, but rural areas and small towns are less open than bigger cities like Lisbon or Porto.
etiquette.es: Portugal es en general un país favorable al colectivo gay, pero las zonas rurales y los pueblos son menos abiertos que ciudades como Lisboa u Oporto.
etiquette.quote: Portugal in general is a gay-friendly country, but don't expect the same openness in rural areas and small towns that you get in the bigger cities like Lisbon or Porto.

etiquette.en: Modern Portugal is described as generally a rather secular society.
etiquette.es: Se describe a la Portugal moderna como una sociedad en general bastante laica.
etiquette.quote: modern Portugal is generally a rather secular society.

etiquette.en: Smoking on public beaches is banned outside designated zones, with fines of up to €2,000.
etiquette.es: Fumar en las playas públicas está prohibido fuera de las zonas designadas, con multas de hasta 2.000 €.
etiquette.quote: Smoking on public beaches is banned outside designated zones. Fines for violation can be as high as €2,000.

etiquette.en: Do not assume that all Portuguese people support or like bullfights.
etiquette.es: No des por hecho que a todos los portugueses les gustan las corridas de toros.
etiquette.quote: Do not assume that all Portuguese people support or even faintly like bullfights.

connectivity.en: To call Portugal from abroad dial country code 351, and to call abroad from Portugal dial 00 before the country code.
connectivity.es: Para llamar a Portugal desde el extranjero marca el prefijo 351, y para llamar al extranjero desde Portugal marca 00 antes del prefijo del país.
connectivity.quote: To call Portugal from abroad, dial country code 351 before the city code. To call abroad from Portugal, dial 00 before the country code.

connectivity.en: Telephone numbers are nine digits long including the city code, and mobile numbers begin with 9.
connectivity.es: Los números de teléfono tienen nueve dígitos, incluido el prefijo de ciudad, y los móviles empiezan por 9.
connectivity.quote: Telephone numbers are nine digits long, including the city code. Mobile numbers begin with 9.
